Chakrabarty, THDC Shri Sarosh M. Siddiqui, THDC _Order in Petition No 172/GT/2015 Page 3 of 43_ 6. In compliance with the directions of the Commission, the petitioner has filed additional information and has served copies on the respondents. The respondents UPPCL and BRPL have filed reply in the matter and the petitioner has filed its rejoinder to the replies. The petitioner has also filed additional information vide affidavit dated 8.9.2016. We now proceed to examine the claim of the petitioner based on the submissions of the parties and the documents available on record, as discussed in the subsequent paragraphs. _Order in Petition No 172/GT/2015 Page 6 of 43_ _Order in Petition No 172/GT/2015 Page 7 of 43_ _Order in Petition No 172/GT/2015 Page 10 of 43_ _Order in Petition No 172/GT/2015 Page 11 of 43_ _Order in Petition No 172/GT/2015 Page 16 of 43_ _Order in Petition No 172/GT/2015 Page 17 of 43_ _Order in Petition No 172/GT/2015 Page 18 of 43_ 17. The respondent UPPCL has submitted that the Commission may reject the request for re-consideration of disallowed expenditure claimed by the petitioner. In response, the petitioner has submitted vide affidavit dated 29.10.2015 that some of the claims of petitioner were not allowed by the Commission in the order dated 27.1.2015 for want of justification and accordingly the petitioner has re-claimed some of the disallowed works citing more justifications as required. We have considered the submissions and proceed to examine the _Order in Petition No 172/GT/2015 Page 19 of 43_ in previous order but approved now based on the justifications submitted by the petitioner is as below: _Order in Petition No 172/GT/2015 Page 25 of 43_ _Order in Petition No 172/GT/2015 Page 26 of 43_ _Order in Petition No 172/GT/2015 Page 27 of 43_ _Order in Petition No 172/GT/2015 Page 28 of 43_ _Order in Petition No 172/GT/2015 Page 29 of 43_ _Order in Petition No 172/GT/2015 Page 33 of 43_ _Order in Petition No 172/GT/2015 Page 34 of 43_ _Order in Petition No 172/GT/2015 Page 35 of 43_ _Order in Petition No 172/GT/2015 Page 36 of 43_ _Order in Petition No 172/GT/2015 Page 37 of 43_ _Order in Petition No 172/GT/2015 Page 38 of 43_ _Order in Petition No 172/GT/2015 Page 39 of 43_ _Order in Petition No 172/GT/2015 Page 41 of 43_ _Order in Petition No 172/GT/2015 Page 43 of 43_
